comment: The canyon steppe's and the stone desert's ground (doc/BIOME_PLAN.md 3.3), painted into <world>_biomes.png by tools/terrain_lab/steppe_ground.py on the biome map's grid. `rel` is where a cell stands between the lowest (0) and the highest (1) ground within `rel_window_m`; `slope` rise over run of the ground smoothed over a cell; `wet` how far the cell lies in a hollow of the ground round it (0 on crests, 1 in the deepest hollows within `wet_window_m`). Each layer, in order, paints its `biome` over the biomes `in` where the ground fits (`slope_min/max`, `rel_min/max`, `wet_max`) and its noise (cells of `noise_m`) weighs over its threshold (`cover` 1: all of it). `mark`: only where steppe_relief.py's mask of that name (<world>_steppe_marks.npz) is set. `relief`: tools/terrain_lab/steppe_relief.py, the mesas cut into the heights before this.

layers.name: stone_walls
layers.comment: the steppe's tops are only its flat high ground: walls and slopes are stone desert

layers.name: mesa_top
layers.comment: every flat tier above the floor: the bare dry tops (canyon_steppe, no grass since 14.10)

layers.name: grass_heart
layers.comment: the burnt orange grass only in the hearts of the biggest islands (user 14.10), from steppe_relief.py's marks

layers.name: canyon_floor
layers.comment: cracked dry crust on the canyons' floors and the approaches: flat low ground, not the wettest hollows (the beds)

layers.name: dry_wash
layers.comment: the dried-up last streams: their washes and the fans at their mouths (steppe_relief.py's marks)

relief.comment: floor: the region's low ground within window_m and the old rivers' valleys (rivers); tops: the land smoothed over top_smooth_m, at least min_drop_m over the floor, cut into flat tiers tier_m high with risers riser_cells wide (sheer: user 14.10, no gentle rises), levels drifting by `drift` of a tier over drift_km, treads rolling roll_m; walls sheer over wall_m, scree scree_m high reaching scree_reach_m out

rivers.comment: the canyons are old rivers' valleys: runoff of the smoothed land (rumpled by route_noise_m over route_noise_km so the rivers wander and gather) to the region's edge (priority flood, D8 on 64 m); a channel where more than min_km2 drains through, its bed depth_m + depth_per_doubling_m per doubling of that area under the filled land (at most depth_of_span of the region's span), its valley width_per_sqrt_km2_m * sqrt(area) wide (width_m limits), the edge wandering by `wander` over wander_km; the floor smoothed over floor_smooth_m, a wash wash_width_m wide down the middle; the valleys bent by bend_m over bend_km; the floor between channels blended from their beds over blend_m; the valley's edge rounded over edge_smooth_m and roughened by edge_rough over edge_km

cracks.comment: the drought (user 14.10): after the rivers the dry broke the high ground up. Each level: cracks along the borders of a warped Voronoi net of cells cell_m (warped by warp_m), width_m wide, open over `open` of the region (the rest of the borders stay whole), only within near_m of the canyons (where the crumbling began) when given

islands.comment: what the crumbling left: an island whose widest point (inner radius) reaches mesa_r_m is a mesa, walkable, its wall stepped once by a bench bench_m wide at bench_rise of its height where it is bench_min_r_m wide (over bench_share of the walls); narrower down to column_r_m: a stone column at column_rise of the tops' height, or (peak_share) worn to a peak at peak_rise (profile power peak_pow); the crumbs below that: a peak (crumb_peak_share) or a heap of rubble rubble_m high. The burnt grass only in the hearts of mesas of heart_km2 or more, heart_m (or heart_share of its inner radius) in from the edge

floor.comment: the canyon's stony floor: fallen blocks round the walls' feet as ledges step_m a step, up to block_m high at a wall fading over block_reach_m (block_far_m anywhere), cells of block_cell_m; the old river's bed kept clear clear_m from its middle; the steps softened over step_soft_cells (sharper ones speckle the shading in motion)

peaks.comment: peaks on the floor, alone and in groups (`group`), wall_m from the islands, more of them near (near_m), per_km2 of floor, gap_m apart: radius_m, rise_m high but at most of_wall of the wall there, profile power pow (1: a cone)

washes.comment: the last streams: runoff of the finished ground (D8, 64 m); a wash where min_km2 drains through on the floor, width_per_sqrt_km2_m * sqrt(area) wide (width_m), depth_m + depth_per_doubling_m per doubling (at most max_depth_m), bent by bend_m; a fan fan_h_m high, fan_per_sqrt_km2_m * sqrt(area) out (fan_r_m), fan_gap_m apart, where a wash leaves a cleft for open floor or reaches the old river's bed (with mouth_min_km2); washes and fans painted dry_wash where they cover mark_share of a 64 m cell

checks.comment: automatic: gentle_share = ground between slope 0.2 and 0.7 off walls, washes and fans (the user wants no gentle rises), floor_connected = share of the canyon floor in its largest piece
